data.fund_type: An open ended equity scheme investing in banking and financial services related sectors
data.investment_objective: The primary investment objective of the scheme is to generate consistent returns by investing in equity and equity related instruments of banking and financial services. There is no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: Equity and Equity related instruments of companies engaged in Banking and Financial Services Sector (including units issued by REITs) :- 80-100% Equity and Equity related instruments of companies other than those engaged in Banking and Financial Services Sector including units issued by REITs) :- 0-20% Debt & Money Market instruments :- 0-20% Units issued by InvITs:- 0-5% Foreign securities including ADRs / GDRs / Foreign equity and debt securities and Overseas ETFs:- 0-20%
data.exit_load: For redemptions / switch outs (including SIP/STP) within 15 days from the date of allotment of units, irrespective of the amount of investment: 1% No exit load shall be applicable on switches from Regular Plan to Direct Plan and vice versa, under the same scheme.
